module: Node "Set Lights" (category `repeat_instant`). Sets the state of the headlights: `core_vehicleBridge.executeAction(veh,'setLightMode', mode)`. `mode`: 0 off, 1 on, 2 high beams. Input pins: `vehId`, `mode`.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

postInit.desc: Defines the templates of `mode` (Off, On, Highbeams).
